account.description: Transparency about what the POC stores and how to delete your account.

demo.title: Demo nature
demo.body: Ultra Hero is a public proof of concept. Heroes are fictional, subscriptions are simulated and orders are tests: there is no real payment, delivery or address.

store.title: What we store
store.item1: Email, display name, avatar (illustration), language, theme and time zone.
store.item2: Interests, favorites, lists, progress, completions and streak.
store.item3: Simulated subscription (modules and periods) and test orders with a fictional destination.
store.item4: Usage events without personal data and optional feedback.
store.not: We do not collect real addresses, geolocation, payment data or individual health data.

retention.title: Retention
retention.orders: Test orders linked to the account: {days} days (then anonymized)
retention.logs: Recommendation runs: {days} days. Hosting and database logs follow each provider's policy (details in the Privacy Policy).
retention.exceptions: Documented exceptions (legal evidence or incident) suspend anonymization while open.

ai.title: AI recommendations
ai.body: Only if enabled by the administration. They receive only opaque ids, tags and pillars — never name or email.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Anonymizes the profile, removes interests, lists and progress, unlinks events and orders and deletes the account. This cannot be undone.
delete.dialogDescription: This action is final. To confirm, type {word} below.

errors.retention_exception_active: There is an active retention exception for this account (legal evidence or incident). Deletion is blocked until it is closed.

demo.title: Nothing is sent in this demo
demo.body: No email or push leaves the app in this version. What you select here is stored as consent and must be respected by any future sending. Transactional messages (sign-up confirmation and password reset) are required for the account to work and cannot be turned off.
